products.body_html:
Performance Meets Practicality. 
Meet the new Dri Lite Sport 3: a lightweight cart bag designed for both style and function. It features an additional pocket on each side with easy-access and valuable organizer system.The two waterproof compartments offer soft linings to protect your valuables. Ideal for golfers seeking a blend of efficiency and aesthetics, all in refreshing colors and modern design.

products.title: Dri Lite SUMMIT
products.body_html: The water-repellent Dri Lite Summit is the ultimate all-round solution for the golfer who likes to push and carry! This ingenious bag sits perfectly square on a push cart thanks to its flat, footless cart compatible base, leg lock feature, and clever  positioning  of  the  stand  mechanism  to  avoid twisting. As a stand bag it excels too, with an ultra light weight, despite its size, 14-waydivider and 7 water-repellent pockets. The Summit offers enough storage space for use on a trolley. BIG MAX Dri Lite bags are suitable for all weather conditions, featuring waterproof material and zippers and are also particularly easy to care for and washable.

products.title: Dri Lite Silencio 3
products.body_html: The Dri Lite Silencio 3 combines a 14-way Silencio top that prevents club rattling with a fresh, premium look. Made from durable nylon and Soft Guard PU, it features two seam sealed zips and waterproof materials to keep your gear dry in any weather. Smart upgrades include a newly designed zinc towel hook with integrated bottle opener, a second hook for added versatility, and an external tee holder. Integrated trolley and cart straps ensure a secure fit, while a mesh organiser in the ball pocket and internal dividers in the side pockets keep everything neatly in place.

products.title: AQUA Sport 3
products.body_html:
The AQUA Sport 3 is a top-of-the-line waterproof golf club bag that is perfect for golfers who demand the best. This bag offers 100% waterproof protection for all of your golf clubs and accessories, keeping them safe and dry during even the heaviest of rainstorms.

Features:

  • 100% waterproof guarantee
  • 9 waterproof pockets for easy organization
  • Rain cover/battery pocket
  • Dual umbrella holder and shoulder strap option
  • I-Dry system from BIG MAX for 100% waterproof material and seams/zippers

Design:

  • Sporty and colorful design
  • High-quality materials built to last

Advantages of AQUA Sport 3 waterproof golf cart bag:

  • Protects your golf equipment in any weather conditions
  • Allows you to play in the rain without worrying about wet equipment
  • Stylish design that stands out on the course
  • Durable and built to last for years of use

No longer worry about wet equipment on the course. The AQUA Sport 3 waterproof golf cart bag is the ideal choice for golfers who demand the best in terms of quality, durability, and performance. With its advanced waterproof technology, organization options, and stylish design make it the ultimate choice for golfers of all skill levels who want to protect their equipment from the elements. So, don't let the rain ruin your game, choose AQUA Sport 3 waterproof golf bag for a guaranteed dry and protected round of golf.

products.title: AQUA UV Umbrella XL
products.body_html: The BIG MAX Aqua UV Umbrella has an easy-to-use automatic function that combines with a soft grip and robust waterproof fabric to provide comfort and protection even in the toughest conditions. And thanks to its UV protection (50+), the umbrella can also be used as a parasol, protecting you on the course whatever the weather! With a diameter of 60in and a neat fabric cover, the BIG MAX Aqua U.V Umbrella brings color to the golf course and co-ordinates perfectly with your favorite BIG MAX bag.

products.title: AQUA UV-Umbrella
products.body_html: The BIG MAX Aqua UV Umbrella has an easy-to-use automatic function that combines with a soft grip and robust waterproof fabric to provide comfort and protection even in the toughest conditions. And thanks to its UV protection (50+), the umbrella can also be used as a parasol, protecting you on the course whatever the weather! With a diameter of 52in and a neat fabric cover, the BIG MAX Aqua U.V Umbrella brings color to the golf course and co-ordinates perfectly with your favorite BIG MAX bag.

products.title: AQUA Bottle - Stainless Steel
products.body_html:
Introducing the AQUA Drinking Bottle, designed specifically for golfers. Crafted from

durable stainless steel, this thermos bottle maintains the temperature of your

beverages—hot or cold—for hours. With inspiration from our waterproof golf bag line,

the Aqua Bottle delivers both style and practicality, keeping your drinks at the perfect

temperature on the course, regardless of the weather.

 

Features

• Reusable from stainless steel with twist cap

• 750ml

• 12 hours hot | 24 hours cold

products.title: Pro Towel
products.body_html:
The BIGMAX Pro Towel is made of durable microfiber. It has an antibacterial and anti-mite effect. The material offers protection against UV rays, is breathable, absorbent and quick-drying. Is available in different colors.

Dimensions: 64 x 49 cm

products.title: Range Finder Magnet Plate
products.body_html: Quick Fix Rangefinder Magnet Plate for all BIG MAX golf trolleys with Quick Fix attachment point. Thanks to the QF system, the accessory can be attached and removed with just one hand.

products.title: Quick Lok Towel
products.body_html: This towel from BIG MAX can be used with the innovative and new QL system (Blade IP2, Trio) as well as with a carabiner for all other push carts. With the included glove holder, you will have your golf glove always at hand. The practical accessories zip bag offers you a useful space for tees, balls, pitch mark repairer at much more.

products.title: AQUA IPX.Tour
products.body_html: Introducing the AQUA IPX.Tour, the world’s first non-stitched, welded golf bag. Crafted with our groundbreaking IPX material and featuring 100% waterproof zippers, it offers an unparalleled level of water resistance. With a 14-way organizer top, XL putter compartment, and a variety of specialized pockets, this bag redefines functionality and waterproof performance.

products.title: Soft Guard PU Headcover
products.body_html:
Made from SoftGuard PU, the new BIG MAX headcovers not only exude high quality and elegance but also perfectly complement our Prime Line introduced last year.

Available in three different sizes, every wood, big or small, is well protected. The headcovers come in five different colors and a simple design.

A must-have accessory for every golfer that radiates style and taste.

Features:

- SoftGuard PU material
- Gusset for better fit
- Handle for better handling
- Set with 3 sizes(Driver, fairway wood, hybrid)
- Matching the BIG MAX Prime collection

products.title: Blade IP 2
products.body_html: Meet the BIG MAX Blade IP 2, the next evolution of our award-winning golf push cart. It retains the groundbreaking FlatFold mechanism with automatically folding rear wheels, ensuring easy storage and transport. Now featuring an enhanced XL organizer panel for extra storage, and a minimalist design with unmatched material quality, the Blade IP 2 is engineered for maximum efficiency and style.

products.title: Dri Lite Silencio Prime
products.body_html: Introducing the Dri Lite Silencio Prime, a golf bag designed to keep your clubs perfectly organized and silent. Featuring a 14-way Silencio top that eliminates club rattling, this bag is crafted from premium SoftGuard PU material, offering a soft, premium feel with water and scratch resistance. Gigantic storage options ensure you have space for everything you need on the course.

products.title: Dri Lite Hybrid Prime
products.body_html: Introducing the Dri Lite Hybrid Prime: the epitome of exceptional softness and adaptability. Crafted in premium PU leather, this versatile golf bag features a hybrid mechanism for effortless cart-to-stand transition. With a 14-way divider and extra-large cooler compartment, it simplifies and elevates every facet of your game. Experience the perfect blend of style and functionality.

products.title: Dri Lite Prime
products.body_html: Introducing the Dri Lite Prime Cart Bag: a fusion of innovation and refinement. With magnetic pockets, your essentials are effortlessly at hand. Crafted from exquisite vegan leather, it offers the discerning golfer a unique premium feel with uncompromising style. A 14-way soft top divider safeguards your clubs, while waterproof value pockets protect you from the elements. The Dri Lite Prime, is a statement of sophisticated performance.

products.title: Dri Lite Hybrid Tour 2
products.body_html: Introducing the Dri Lite Hybrid Tour 2. Building on the success of its predecessor, it offers more storage, a refined design, and premium materials. With our signature hybrid technology and water-resistant construction, it’s reimagined for those who seek more from every round. Sleek, functional, and unmistakably advanced.

products.title: Complete Frame + Wheel Axle for Blade+
Blade Trio
products.body_html:
The Blade Trio is the latest evolution of BIG MAX Flat-Fold technology. It is the most compact, stable and durable BIG MAX push cart and raises the bar for functionality. Its primary advantage is the combination of compactness, stability and that it is very easy to push.

 It also folds easier than any other push cart, while using one of our established BIG MAX Autofold systems. The Trio is smaller and more compact than any other push cart on the market, while delivering all a golfer needs on the course.

products.title: Dri Lite Silencio 2
products.body_html: The new Silencio 2 from BIG MAX is lightweight and water-resistant thanks to the Dri Lite technology. With the 14-way Silencio Divider, clubs are held in place, eliminating all knocking together of clubs and the associated noise. The organizer accommodates oversized putter grips, while the pocket layout allows for optimal organization of valuables. Water-resistant Dri Lite technology with waterproof zippers keeps gear dry finishing off this innovative, reliable and well thought out golf bag.

products.title: Dri Lite Hybrid Plus
products.body_html: The new Dri Lite Hybrid Plus is the latest addition to our Hybrid line. The Hybrid Plus has a completely revised design, even more storage space and a cooling compartment that is twice as large. With the integrated Value Organizer you can store your valuables safely and separately. Like all Dri Lite bags, the Hybrid Plus is made of waterproof material and waterproof zippers and as part of the Hybrid line, the golf bag fits perfectly on any push cart.

products.title: Dri Lite Travel Bag
products.body_html: The DRI LITE Travel Bag is a water resistant travelcover that is packed with features that make travelling with your clubs simple. it can store up to two golf bags (7”). Two shoe bags, upright loading, internal bag fix and protection from the elements make the Dri Lite travel cover perfect for the golfer on the go.

products.title: Blade Super Net
products.body_html: This spacious and practical Super Net for Blade IP push carts offers a huge amount of storage space, easy and fast to fix thanks to useful velcro fastener.

products.title: IQ+ Travel Bag
products.body_html: Have your new BIG MAX IQ+ always protected and with you. With the new transport bag for BIG MAX IQ+ push cart you can also keep your car and locker clean.

products.title: Blade Travel Bag
products.body_html:
Clean and protected – the BIG MAX transport bag for the Blade trolley can do both
Have your new BIG MAX Blade IP always protected and with you. With the BIG MAX transport bag for the Blade push cart, you can also keep your car and locker clean.

products.title: Pushcart Wall Hook
products.body_html: The storage hook can be used for nearly all BIG MAX push carts. The hook can be fixed to a wall using the included screws or on a slat wall with the bracket (also included).

products.title: Quick Lok Beverage Holder
products.body_html: With the golf beverage holder from BIG MAX, you’ll always have your refreshments ready and waiting. Using the smart Quick Lok system our golf cart drink holder is simple to attach and stays secure around the course. Just click it on the handle of your BIG MAX push cart (Blade IP, IQ+, Autofold+/FF) and have your drinks always with you. Buy now and get this great accessory to add to your golf cart for quick delivery.

products.title: Quick Lok Range Finder Case
products.body_html: Small and handy – this is the new Range Finder Bag from BIG MAX. With the practical Quick Lok System, you can place your Range Finder bag directly on the handle of your push cart. Suitable for all standard range finder and distance measurement devices.

products.title: Quick Fix Phone Holder
products.body_html:
The Quick Fix Phone Holder for your BIG MAX push cart offers a perfect hands-free solution for navigating the course. It attaches quickly and easily, thanks to the QF base found on most BIG MAX push carts, allowing you to install this golf cart GPS holder in seconds. The holder is fully adjustable to accommodate various smartphone sizes.

• Adjustable neck
• Padded, adjustable grips for a secure hold
• Suitable for smartphones or GPS devices up to 8.5 cm wide

products.title: Rain Safe System
products.body_html: The patented RAIN SAFE by BIG MAX is the ideal rain cover for every golf bag. The shapely and discreetly coordinated RAIN SAFE is attached to the upper area of the golf bag by means of a belt with a click fastener and is therefore always within reach and usable.

products.title: Drop Stop Rainsystem
products.body_html: The new Drop Stop Rainsystem from BIG MAX is more than a standard rain cover for your golf cart bag and clubs. In a few seconds your golf kit is safe from the rain – with two clicks and the new Quick attach System, you can fix your Drop Stop Rain Cover to the bag holder on your push cart. Thanks to its patented rain hood you can easily and quickly access your clubs, without tedious fiddling – it’s quick, easy and dry.

products.title: Quick Fix CLASSIC Umbrella Holder
products.body_html: The BIG MAX Quick Fix Classic Golf Umbrella holder is a “must have” for all BIG MAX push carts and an upgrade to our standard golf cart umbrella holder. With our push carts already having a base for the umbrella holder, it’s easy to install in just a few seconds. The Classic golf umbrella holder keeps your umbrella safely in place and protects your bag and your clubs even more securely. The design of the QF golf umbrella holder Classic helps you focus on your game and not on any wet clubs or flying umbrellas. So, you can enjoy your game even under the most extreme wet weather conditions.

products.title: Universal Mesh Bag
products.body_html:
Practical Mesh Bag for all things you need on your golf round.
The mesh bag from BIG MAX offers your enough space accessories and much more needed things during your round. Thanks to the velcro fasteners you can fix it very easy and quick on your push cart.

Fits Blade IP, Auto Fold and Ti Lite pushcart frame.

products.title: Cooler bag (Blade IP only)
products.body_html:
Enough fresh and cool beverage during your golf round.

The cooler bag for Blade IP offers enough space for your beverages and keeps them cool and fresh for a whole round of golf.

products.title: BIG MAX Wheel Cover
products.body_html: This useful wheel cover for your BIG MAX push cart is made of sturdy nylon and has a practical elastic band for fast fixing. The wheel cover keeps your caddybox or car clean.

products.title: Quick Lok Glove Holder
products.body_html: This simple but smart glove holder can be fixed very easily and quickly on the QL base of your push cart. Have your glove always within reach. A pitch mark repair tool and a ball marker comes along with this glove holder as an extra feature.
